propositions: CodeQL workflow cadence changed from weekly (23 4 * * 1) to 6-hourly (35 */6 * * *) to replace the push-on-main trigger that was removed in change 03ef-6fb5-158b-4abd.

CodeQL's weekly cron was originally a backstop for advisories between pushes; after push trigger removal it became the primary scan mechanism, leaving newly-introduced SAST findings unscanned for up to 7 days.
The 6-hourly scheduled CI lanes (test, optionality, verify-identity, codeql) use staggered off-the-hour minutes (41, 47, 53, 35) to avoid GitHub scheduler congestion at hour boundaries.
CodeQL workflow has no push trigger and retains workflow_dispatch, so it cannot join the _SIX_HOURLY cohort that also validates push-preservation for non-main branches.
Test file test_ci_main_push_policy.py was retargeted to validate CodeQL's new 6-hourly cadence, distinct-minute staggering invariant, and no-push/workflow_dispatch preservation, rather than deleted.
Cost rationale for weekly cadence ('28x increase') was removed because navapbc/rebar is a public repository where CodeQL and GitHub Actions minutes are free.
